verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a generic third-party plugin marketplace and a local HTTP API server with bearer-token access, but nothing documents first-party AI or LLM connectors or any AI-specific plugins. The HTTP API is a developer building block that someone could use to build an AI integration, not the capability itself. The community comment about using Claude or Codex to update pages describes a user-side workaround, not a product feature, so none of this earns credit.
